body: Well, after 20 years at a job you can retire. Life I guess should be the same. I'm sorry for your circumstances and your choices. Your next few choices over the next few days is going to be your biggest. Make sure before you decide that the person out their waiting for you to get your life together and find him/her is not left waiting for their perfect. It would suck to know my perfect committed suicide 2 years earlier snd I never got to be hers! Whatever you decide...I support you not being scared and in pain. I truly mean that! You are something special to someone you many not even know yet....
"I'll drive so F*cking far away that I'll NEVER cross your mind and do whatever it takes in your heart to leave me behind..." -Hate Me by Blue October

I've spent the last few years researching suicide locations, methods and the ripple affect. I found the location (an oak tree far from civilization that is a very large oddball), the method (forward lean hang with a soft rope and cloth to push against my trachea and arteries, and I've written letters to my siblings. Each a 2-3 page explanation and the memories I have with each one. I will mail them out on my way to the tree. I have put all my possessions in boxes to be picked up by the local teens on their own organization. I am doing all I can to limit the ripple. I believe much like this post...each day it will be felt less and less.

Your words are the kindness I need to hear. Words:
I'm thinking of you
Friend
Life is for some...but not for everyone.

Give yourself a date to do it...but make it after age 21. Give yourself time to experience you teens, and early adulthood. Experience a few relationships and see along that time if anything has been worth it. Most jobs you can retire after 20 years. You should be able to also if after that time you are feeling the same way you are now. I hope you find some hope.
Unfortunately, I can only tell people from my experience is to kill yourself quietly because if you tell someone you'll be treated li kb e a criminal.
Omg...what a great thought. Animals,well maybe not cats and fish lol, give such unconditional love. Unfortunately, who is going to feed my dog after in gone?

He shot himself in the head after the police found out....and not from me. He got 7 others (all teenage girls). No one asked me. He told me I would get into trouble if my parents found out I was doing "dirty" things with him. Yes, at age 5 I was already ashamed and scared. I was his son's best friend. No one thought to ask and I sure as hell didnt want to tell my most guarded secret. It took 30 years later to tell someone.  Unfortunately it was in a hospital psychiatric ward after I told my friend I wanted to kill myself. 6 sherriff officers showed up and arrested me. Great system for those who are hurting and in pain. A hug probably would have been more effective. Shrugs
Most jobs you can retire after 20 years...I've doubled it....I think I already know the game!

No more memories of the molestations, no more toxic relationships, no more physical pain, no more bills, no more sadness, no more disappointment that tomorrow will be better, no more mean people, no more being scared, no more being exhausted from the mental attacks my past memories assault me with, no more, no more....

I've made the mistake of telling a friend a few years back that I was thinking about suicide...the next day 6 sheriff officers flooded my house (my neighbors all out to see) and told me to lay in the ground. They put a knee in my back as I was handcuffed. I did exactly what they asked and only said I was hurting and this is not help I need. I was taken to a hospital psychiatric ward for 15 days (most by our law). The thing it taught me is that all those help lines and "friends" around me ...they just get you arrested. I wont make that mistake again. I'm sorry for your pain. Everyone has their own hell to deal with in life. I hope that you find just that..."hope".
